chunks: What Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh narrated from Aḥmad ibn al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAmr ibn Saʿīd al-Madāʾinī, from Muṣaddiq ibn Ṣadaqah, from ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā al-Sābāṭī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about salat al-maghrib when its time has entered: is it permissible to delay it for an hour? He said: There is no harm. If he is fasting, he breaks his fast; and if he has a need, he fulfills it, then he prays.

key_terms.إِذَا حَضَرَتْ: when its prescribed time has entered
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to delay salat al-maghrib after its time begins?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the time of salat al-maghrib after its onset. It indicates that delaying the prayer for a period is permissible in certain circumstances, such as breaking one’s fast or attending to an immediate need before performing the prayer.
